verifiedFacts: The audited complete take 9 MCAP exposes 12 directed pairwise throughput channels.
The audited MCAP channels do not expose measured latency, packet-loss, or jitter fields.
The mini release contains no MCAP trace.
The allowed timing and identity evidence consists of MCAP log time, MCAP publish time, LiDAR timestamp, sender identity, and receiver identity.
Per-model payload must be measured from the executable model path rather than inferred from a project-page claim.
interpretationLimits: A throughput channel is a measured link-rate time series, not a packet-delivery log.
A completion time derived by integrating payload over throughput is a replay construct and must not be described as measured end-to-end latency.
MCAP log time, MCAP publish time, and LiDAR timestamp are distinct clocks until an explicit alignment contract is verified.
The absence of latency, packet-loss, and jitter fields prevents claims about those phenomena.
The take 9 schema audit does not establish trace availability or schema consistency for the other 13 takes.
The project page is discovery context only and is not accepted as evidence of an MCAP field.

orderingNote: Candidate order is an identifier sequence only and does not encode priority, preference, or evaluation.

candidates.title: 吞吐积分驱动的模型载荷完成回放

从对齐后的 LiDAR timestamp 开始积分可传输 bit 数，达到 payload bit 数时标记完成；未达到时只标记未完成，不合成丢包或额外时延。
冻结模型检查点和 LiDAR 样本，比较固定 1.6 Mbps、现有帧取整和 throughput 积分完成回放。

对每个版本运行相同 completion replay，比较完成时刻、截止时间前完成比例和冻结模型结果。
寻找能复现原始序列结论的最短块长度，不训练网络生成器。

candidates.title: 十二条定向链路的同步吞吐结构审计
